_source: ADOSH-SF Technical Guideline 'Process of Risk Management', Version 4.0, 15 July 2024 (Abu Dhabi Public Health Centre): Table 1 (consequence, p. 9), Table 2 (likelihood, p. 10), Table 3 (risk rating, p. 10), Sec. 5.3.4(c) hierarchy of control (p. 11). Values marked 'project' are this project's own choices. See docs/risk_matrix_source.md.

guideline.name: ADOSH-SF Technical Guideline – Process of Risk Management

1.name: Insignificant
1.definition: Minor injuries, which may require self-administered first aid. Injured personnel can continue to perform normal duties.
1.production_loss: Incident event without causing production loss.
1.cost: Financial loss (compensation, fines, cost to repair, plant damage) of less than AED5,000.

2.name: Minor
2.definition: Injuries requiring on-site treatment by medical practitioner. Personnel unable to continue to perform duties.
2.production_loss: Production loss or delay up to one week.
2.cost: Financial loss (compensation, fines, cost to repair, plant damage) of AED5,000 - AED50,000.

3.name: Moderate
3.definition: Serious injuries requiring off-site medical treatment by medical practitioner or immediate evacuation to hospital. Potential long-term or permanently disabling effects.
3.production_loss: Production loss or delay of one week to one month.
3.cost: Financial loss (compensation, fines, cost to repair, plant damage) of AED50,000 - AED500,000

4.name: Major
4.production_loss: Production loss or delay for over one month.
4.cost: Financial loss (compensation, fines, cost to repair, plant damage) of AED500,000 - AED10M.

5.name: Catastrophic
5.production_loss: Loss of licence to operate or ability to produce indefinitely.
5.cost: Severe financial penalties or legal liabilities. Financial loss (compensation, fines, cost to repair, plant damage) of greater than AED10M.

1.name: Rare
1.history_rule: No similar hazard in this area in the last 365 days

2.name: Possible
2.history_rule: 1 similar hazard in the last 365 days

3.name: Likely
3.history_rule: 2 similar hazards in the last 365 days

4.name: Often
4.history_rule: 3-5 similar hazards in the last 365 days

5.name: Frequent / Almost certain
5.history_rule: 6 or more similar hazards in the last 365 days

bands.action: No immediate action required, unless escalation of risk is possible.
Activity or industry can operate subject to management and /or modification.
Activity or industry should be modified to include remedial planning and action and be subject to detailed OSH assessment.
Activity or industry should not proceed in current form.

_bands_note: min/max cover 1-25 without gaps. Scores 7, 11, 13 and 14 are not products of two levels 1-5 and never occur; the guideline's printed ranges are in guideline_range. target_days are project-defined: the guideline sets no time frames.

hierarchy_of_controls.name: Substitution
hierarchy_of_controls.guideline: substitution (eg. use a less hazardous substances )

hierarchy_of_controls.name: Engineering / isolation
hierarchy_of_controls.guideline: engineering / isolation - for plant and equipment (e.g. exhaust ventilation)

hierarchy_of_controls.name: Procedural
hierarchy_of_controls.guideline: procedural (e.g. via improving work methods, housekeeping)

hierarchy_of_controls.name: PPE (last resort)
hierarchy_of_controls.guideline: personal protective equipment (PPE) – it is the last resort if the above measures are not practicable
